verdict.rationale: Better Auth's own security docs say a logged-in user can revoke their own sessions to log out from different devices or browsers, so user-side session revocation is a documented built-in capability. The admin plugin evidence covers banning and impersonation but never admin-side session viewing or revocation, and the 2FA 'trusted devices' feature is a different capability. Missing for 10: documented listing of active sessions and devices, admin ability to view or revoke other users' sessions, an explicit revoke-individually versus revoke-all distinction, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can let users and admins see active sessions and devices and revoke them individually or all at once

citations.quote: A logged in user can also revoke their own sessions to log out from different devices or browsers.
The session expires after 7 days by default.
